description: This file implements a watch mode loop for the Playwright testing framework, managing test execution, file change detection, user input handling, and browser reuse via a server. It includes classes for transport communication, functions for running tests, and UI prompts for user interaction.

classes.name: InMemoryTransport
classes.description: A custom transport class implementing TestServerTransport, facilitating in-memory message passing for test server communication.

methods.name: runWatchModeLoop
methods.description: Main asynchronous function managing the watch mode loop, handling test execution, file change detection, user commands, and browser server toggling.

methods.name: readKeyPress
methods.description: Utility function to read keypress events from stdin, handling user input for commands.

methods.name: runTests
methods.description: Function to initiate test runs with specified options, supporting interruption via keypress.

methods.name: readCommand
methods.description: Function to interpret user keypresses into commands for controlling the test runner.

methods.name: printConfiguration
methods.description: Outputs current test run configuration and status to the terminal.

methods.name: printBufferPrompt
methods.description: Displays prompt when in buffer mode, indicating file changes and available actions.

methods.name: printPrompt
methods.description: Displays waiting prompt for file changes and user commands.

methods.name: toggleShowBrowser
methods.description: Toggles the in-memory browser server used for reusing browsers during tests.
